summary: Public projects created on 12 April 2026: 5 repos.
intro: Several repositories cover AI tooling: an archive of structured ideation sessions, a list of memory resources, and a multi-model deliberation app with peer review. Others address infrastructure and media, including an HTTP file staging service for MCP servers and a desktop app that syncs podcast episodes to a micro SD card.
